clue.text: Sprinkler required after Penny gets border plant

indicators.note: after places the sprinkler word behind the penny-and-border pieces

parts.note: a rim is an edge or border
the rose is the perforated sprinkler head on a watering can

explanation.surface: A gardener buys a watering-can rose, pays a penny and gets a plant for the flower border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Required after' says the sprinkler comes after P and RIM; 'gets' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: The primrose is a common pale-yellow spring flower, so it is an example of a plant.

clue.text: Quick and easy victory in gymnastics

indicators.note: in puts the easy victory inside the gymnastics letters

parts.note: PT is physical training, school gymnastics
a romp is a walkover win

explanation.surface: A swift, easy win in a gymnastics competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Done without delay, punctual and speedy: synonyms for fast.

clue.text: High standards of ladies become corrupted

indicators.note: become corrupted means the letters of the women are spoiled and reordered

explanation.surface: Well-bred women's lofty principles have been debased.
explanation.definitionFit: Principles or standards of perfection someone aims to live up to.

clue.text: Drink in training review

definitions.meaning: an informal word for a reviving drink

explanation.surface: Having a drink during a review of staff training.
explanation.definitionFit: A drink revives you, and a course that updates skills learnt earlier has the same name.

clue.text: Presently about to fall over transport — drawing amusement?

indicators.note: about means the presently word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: presently means soon
to trip is to stumble and fall
a cart is a means of transport

explanation.surface: Someone is about to fall over a vehicle while drawing something funny.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the definition as playful: a comic drawing that amuses.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic strip is a sequence of funny drawings, so a drawing intended for amusement.

clue.text: Members of the aristocracy lounge on Sunday

parts.note: a lounge bar is a room in a pub, so lounge can stand for bar

explanation.surface: Aristocrats idle about on a Sunday.
explanation.definitionFit: Barons are titled noblemen, the lowest rank of the British peerage.

clue.text: Saw one's daughter get on

parts.note: A means one, as in a single thing
to get on is to grow older, to age

explanation.surface: A parent saw that their daughter was getting on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a verb, but it is the noun meaning an old saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or proverb, a traditional piece of wisdom.

clue.text: Absolutely impossible Conservative

parts.note: something out of the question is impossible, so out
the political right is conservative

explanation.surface: A Conservative who is utterly impossible.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adverb it means completely, totally, without reservation.

clue.text: Dismiss Greek characters in team

indicators.note: in puts the Greek letters inside the team word

parts.note: a side is a sports team
eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet; etas is the plural

explanation.surface: Dropping Greek players from the team.
explanation.definitionFit: To put aside or reject, e.g. a court overturning a verdict.

clue.text: Begin hostilities in a hot place

definitions.meaning: to start shooting at an enemy
a fire burning in an open grate is a hot spot in a room

explanation.surface: Starting a war somewhere sweltering.
explanation.definitionFit: To start firing weapons begins a fight; a hearth fire with no stove door is a warm place.

clue.text: Wine stored in port and aged

indicators.note: stored in means the wine is kept inside the port letters

parts.note: Asti is a sparkling Italian wine

explanation.surface: A wine kept in a harbour cellar and allowed to mature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like another wine, but here it is just PT.
explanation.definitionFit: Colloquially, someone too old to do something well is described as being over the hill, i.e. aged.

clue.text: Chain of events making me infect food, accidentally

indicators.note: accidentally means the letters of the three words are jumbled by chance

explanation.surface: A sequence of mishaps led to me accidentally contaminating food.
explanation.definitionFit: A cumulative sequence where one occurrence triggers the next, like toppling tiles.

clue.text: Seeds taking some beating

definitions.meaning: edible seeds of legumes such as lentils and peas
a rhythmic throb, as of the heart

explanation.surface: Seeds take a bit of a battering.
explanation.definitionFit: Lentils, beans and peas are collectively called this; it is also the throb of the arteries.

clue.text: Pinochet's muddled analysis of speech

indicators.note: muddled means the letters of the dictator's name are mixed up

explanation.surface: The Chilean dictator Pinochet's confused attempt to analyse speech.
explanation.walkthrough: The S of 'Pinochet's' is used as a letter here.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the branch of linguistics that studies speech sounds and their production.

clue.text: A place for cropping trials in Slough

indicators.note: in puts the trials word inside the slough word

parts.note: to slough is to cast off, like a snake's skin, so to shed
court trials are hearings

explanation.surface: Legal trials being held in the Berkshire town of Slough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slough' looks like the town in Berkshire, but it is the verb meaning cast off. 'Cropping' means clipping fleeces.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheep are clipped of their wool in this farm building, cropping being cutting short.

clue.text: German aristocrat always found in a car

parts.note: an earl is a nobleman
ever means always

explanation.surface: A German nobleman is forever being spotted in a car.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is descriptive: the thing in question is a part of a car.
explanation.definitionFit: The stick used to change gear in a vehicle is part of a car.

clue.text: Lady reading about writer is a spoilsport

indicators.note: about means the lady and reading letters go around the writer

parts.note: a dame is a titled lady
a pen is a writing instrument
R is reading, one of the three Rs of education

explanation.surface: A lady reading about an author turns out to be a killjoy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who puts a damper on things spoils the fun for everyone else.

clue.text: Primate accepts Paul's dubious accolade

indicators.note: accepts means the primate takes the other letters inside

parts.note: an ape is a primate

indicators.note: dubious means the letters of Paul's name are of doubtful order and rearranged

explanation.surface: An archbishop accepts a dubious award from Paul.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Primate' looks like a senior bishop but is the animal. The S of 'Paul's' is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Clapping expresses praise, as an accolade does.

clue.text: Ambitious and venomous reptile, one that's intelligent

parts.note: an asp is a poisonous snake
I is the Roman numeral for one
rational means able to think sensibly

explanation.surface: An ambitious, venomous and clever snake.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with hopes of rising in the world, wanting to get ahead, is ambitious.

clue.text: Enclosure puts Rex in the pink

indicators.note: in puts the king's letter inside the colour

parts.note: coral is a pinkish-red colour
R stands for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Rex, a dog perhaps, is in the pink, i.e. in perfect health.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen for livestock, especially cattle or horses.

clue.text: Ambassador in sight of guillotine

indicators.note: in puts the ambassador inside the sight

parts.note: a bead is the foresight on a gun barrel
HE is His Excellency, an ambassador's title

explanation.surface: An ambassador in view of the guillotine.
explanation.definitionFit: To guillotine someone is to decapitate them.

clue.text: European's gone? Put away

parts.note: a Polish person is from Poland, in Europe
off means departed, gone away

explanation.surface: A European has left: someone is asking for him to be locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put away' means eat up quickly, not imprison.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrasal verbs are idioms for consuming food or drink entirely and quickly.

clue.text: Foreigner is initially Sheffield United player

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the city name

parts.note: wed means joined together, united
E is East, one of the four players at bridge

explanation.surface: A foreign footballer turns out for Sheffield United.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sheffield United' looks like a club name; it splits into a first letter and a word for married. E is East, a seat at the bridge table.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scandinavian from Sweden is a foreigner to a British solver.

clue.text: Promiscuous European after the toilets

parts.note: loo is British slang for a toilet, so the toilets are the loos

explanation.surface: A sleazy European loitering behind the public toilets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' tells you E is placed behind LOOS.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of lax morals sexually can be described with this adjective, as in 'a woman of loose morals'.

clue.text: Doctor broke tureen

indicators.note: broke means the letters of the dish are shattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: The doctor smashed a soup dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a medic or an anagram signal, but here it is the verb meaning castrate.
explanation.definitionFit: To doctor an animal is to castrate or spay it, a euphemistic sense.

clue.text: Wayward congressman rejected poetry

indicators.note: rejected means the congressman's short title is turned back to front

parts.note: Rep is short for a Representative in the US Congress
verse is poetry

explanation.surface: A wayward member of Congress turned down some poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe someone contrary, deliberately behaving in an unreasonable way.

clue.text: Mention hiding earl's jacket

indicators.note: hiding means the mention word conceals the earl's letter inside it

parts.note: to refer to something is to mention it
E is an abbreviation for earl

explanation.surface: Someone mentions concealing a nobleman's jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a short, thick, double-breasted coat originally worn by sailors.

clue.text: Pioneer showed the way in a state of shock

parts.note: to pioneer something is to start it
led means guided or showed the way

explanation.surface: A trailblazing explorer leading the way, though shaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Being suddenly surprised or alarmed leaves someone shocked.
